title: Globe Hall's location and George on playing there
summary: They place Globe Hall near St. Claude and St. Peter; George says he played there and recalls it becoming a boxing arena and broom factory.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Was the Globes Hall built there?
Not around there, no. It was just from St. Claude to Ramport, from St. Peter to St. Anne.
No Globes Hall in those days.
Was the Globes Hall around that neighborhood there?
Globe Hall was at the corner of St. Peter. Well, that was in the neighborhood.
St. Pierre and St. Claude. St. Claude.
And it was up in those times, Globes Hall. Yeah, because I had an opportunity to play the Globes Hall myself when they had a theater.
I wonder what they did with Globes Hall.
And then they made a boxing arena. And then they turned it into a broom factory. My two first children was born right in that neighborhood.
And you think they tore it down about? Around about 20...
Around about 27, 28 something. That's like... Oh, yeah, they're tearing everything down now. Want some coffee, Mom?
